figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of our bounded-compute regression pipeline. A fixed-resolution image and truncated text metadata are encoded into a multimodal token sequence, processed by SmolVLM2, pooled into a single representation, and mapped to a scalar rating by a lightweight MLP head.

Figure 2. Hexbin density of rounded predictions versus rounded ground-truth ratings on the validation set. Predictions are rounded to one decimal place for visualization to match the label granularity. The dashed red line denotes perfect prediction.
